# Frozen extension reference

Offline compatibility fixtures, not a deployable extension release.
The existing extension workflow is RETIRED/FROZEN. Do not upload, activate or re-enable it.
The browser test blocks external traffic and checks historical manifest load order and
seven-phase/three-step rendering only. updater/updater.js contains a local terminal-state
compatibility candidate; it is not the canonical published extension.
